cases.title: Valid booking is accepted and stored exactly as sent
Checkout before checkin is rejected on create
cases.why: The BK-1043 case: checkin 15 Aug, checkout 12 Aug, nights -3.

cases.title: Zero-night stay (checkout = checkin) is rejected
cases.why: Assumption: Nuzul does not sell day-use stays. Confirm with the team.

cases.title: Impossible calendar date (30 Feb) is rejected, not rolled over
cases.why: A silent rollover produces a real-looking but wrong date.

cases.title: Day/month string 12/08/2026 is rejected, not reinterpreted
cases.why: Same format as BK-1043. A caller in Riyadh means 12 August.

cases.title: Empty checkout is rejected
cases.why: What a voice agent may send when it did not catch the date.

cases.title: Missing bookingdates is rejected with 400, not a server crash
PATCH cannot move checkout before checkin
cases.why: The path used when a caller changes their checkout on the phone.

cases.title: PUT cannot replace a booking with reversed dates
PATCH without a token is refused and changes nothing
